WITH scoped AS (
 SELECT * FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA WHERE logicalRegionName='region-test'
), tenant_counts AS (
 SELECT tenantId, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS resource_count
 FROM scoped WHERE tenantId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tenantId
), winners AS (
 SELECT tenantId, resource_count FROM tenant_counts
 WHERE resource_count=(SELECT MAX(resource_count) FROM tenant_counts)
), mounts AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT vmId, volumeId FROM R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM
), scoped_volumes AS (
 SELECT * FROM CLOUD_VOLUME WHERE logicalRegionName='region-test'
)
SELECT w.tenantId AS tenant_id, d.tenantName AS tenant_name, w.resource_count,
 d.id AS vm_id,d.name AS vm_name,d.ipAddress AS ip_address,d.privateIps AS private_ips,d.floatingIp AS floating_ip,
 m.volumeId AS referenced_volume_id,v.id AS volume_id,v.name AS volume_name,
 v.size AS volume_size_raw,v.status AS volume_status,
 CASE WHEN m.vmId IS NULL THEN 'no_mount' WHEN v.id IS NULL THEN 'unresolved_volume' ELSE 'resolved' END AS mount_status
FROM winners w JOIN scoped d ON d.tenantId=w.tenantId
LEFT JOIN mounts m ON m.vmId=d.id
LEFT JOIN scoped_volumes v ON v.id=m.volumeId
ORDER BY w.tenantId,d.id,m.volumeId

g AS (SELECT logicalRegionName,vdcId,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT vdcName)=1 THEN MIN(vdcName) END dn,

 FROM v WHERE vdcId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY logicalRegionName,vdcId),

SELECT w.logicalRegionName AS logical_region_name,w.vdcId AS vdc_id,w.dn AS vdc_name,w.n AS volume_count,

WITH parents AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT id, name, nativeId, logicalRegionName FROM CLOUD_ROUTER
 WHERE logicalRegionName='region-test' AND vdcName='vdc-test'
), refs AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS vpc_id, r.subnetId AS subnet_id
 FROM parents p JOIN CLOUD_PORT t
 ON t.devNativeId=p.nativeId AND t.logicalRegionName=p.logicalRegionName
 JOIN R_PORT_IN_SUBNET r ON r.portId=t.id
 WHERE r.subnetId IS NOT NULL AND r.subnetId<>''
), subnet_counts AS (
 SELECT r.vpc_id, COUNT(*) AS referenced_subnet_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CLOUD_SUBNET s WHERE s.id=r.subnet_id AND s.logicalRegionName='region-test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_subnet_count
 FROM refs r GROUP BY r.vpc_id
), eip_counts AS (
 SELECT e.routerId AS vpc_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS known_eip_count
 FROM CLOUD_FLOATING_IPS e JOIN parents p ON p.id=e.routerId
 WHERE e.logicalRegionName='region-test' GROUP BY e.routerId
)
SELECT p.id AS vpc_id, p.name AS vpc_name,
 COALESCE(s.resolved_subnet_count,0) AS resolved_subnet_count,
 COALESCE(s.referenced_subnet_count,0) AS referenced_subnet_count,
 COALESCE(s.referenced_subnet_count,0)-COALESCE(s.resolved_subnet_count,0) AS unresolved_subnet_count,
 COALESCE(e.known_eip_count,0) AS known_eip_count
FROM parents p LEFT JOIN subnet_counts s ON s.vpc_id=p.id
LEFT JOIN eip_counts e ON e.vpc_id=p.id ORDER BY p.id
